en: You lost?
Keep it short.
What?
Speak.
Can we talk?
Need to talk to you.
Let me ask you something.
Got anything to trade?
Anything you want to trade?
Let's trade.
Sure.
No haggling.
Yeah.
Yeah.
Right.
Volodymyr sent me.
Looking into something for your boss.
Taking care of some pests.
Gunners took over this spot, too?
That a complaint or a challenge?
It's a complaint. Need to go South.
No. Things are bad over there. We're not guarding. We're blocking.
Sparing you and your kind from some shit. Don't be ungrateful.
What if it's a challenge?
I'll cut off your eyes and tongue. If I fail, someone else will do it for me. There will be many in line.
Then we'll put you in chains and take you West. You'll have a very bad life.
You survived the Villa. Don't just throw that away.
Neither.
I don't do small talk.
You always been a Gunner? Worth it?
Yes. Consistent group, clear rules. Can use my skills.
No time wasted on god, corpses, trains, mantras, collectivism. We just solve basic problems. Treat people as they deserve.
Got disagreements, solve them then and there. That's the way. And I'm good at winning arguments.
Who gave you that scar, then?
Why? Want your own?
Sounds like the Palatines.
No. They waste all their time on the past.
Dressing up like pre-War soldiers. Drinking, lazing around.
Like the world's the same as it was. When the Continent was strong.
You distribute drugs and alcohol?
Part of my job. Business is good.
Have other skills too. But you won't ask about those.
Sounds like you don't have any beliefs.
Make decisions based on tangible things.
Morality doesn't matter, being big and strong does. God is a dream, Mist is right here killing us.
A second spent believing stupid shit is a second not spent on food, shelter, strength.
About the substances you sell...
You're looking?
I'll get going.
Business is good, then?
Yes. People come to us easily. Word spreads. We barely have to move.
Hunger, pain, misery. That's what makes good customers.
Genetics, too.
How do Commonfolk afford this?
We're flexible. We take food, work, or favors. We let them come to owe us.
Same thing with Rada, Acolytes.
Even Acolytes buy drugs and alcohol?
In secret. Religious types are freaks when they break the chains.
Everyone needs an escape. It's why we're expanding.
Favors...? How are those paid?
Depends. Best if you don't know the details.
I'll share this. Sometimes we need a fool to hold a gun and run at the Palatines. Well, not "need", it's amusing. Good for morale.
But you might fit that description too.
Changing the subject.
On second thought, I have to go.
Vulture. They told me to expect you.
You went to the Microrayon?
Yeah, got proof right here. (Give Fake Dog Tag)
Yeah, had to take out a whole squad...
Not interested in details. Got proof or not?
Yeah, right here. (Give Fake Dog Tag)
Okay, good. One down, one left.
Your guy decided to load up and hide within the thick of the Mist. At the Lumber Fissure to the North. Thinks he's safe there.
He'll be waiting for you. Get yourself ready too.
Where is my target again?
Lumber Fissure. North of here. Lots of Mist and Mutants.
Don't just rush in. Be prepared.
Who's the guy I'm going for?
Same as last. Went to spy on Palatines, joined them instead. A piece of shit. Kill him slow.
He'll be geared up for sure. Intel says he stole from Palatine colleagues before holing up in there.
Good news is, he'll be scared. Scared people are easier to kill.
No reward for getting the first guy?
You think I'm dumb. Spells danger for you.
I know the deal. Don't play me. Nobody would miss you.
No more questions, I'll get going.
You came here empty-handed?
I'll get around to the job soon.
Don't lower your guard around me, Vulture.
Had some questions first.
Forgot to ask before. Like child.
Got him? Hm. Did better than expected.
Thought you'd only wear him down, make him move. Misjudged you.
You should see the boss up at the camp.
You're staying here?
I'm needed here.
Got any more turncoats to handle?
That's need-to-know.
